note: All 97 main article images inspected, including off-model historical/event/chronograph images; related-post thumbnails and avatars excluded. Actual pixels plus article identification establish selections. Technical calibre text is not a movement photograph.

reviewedArticles.referenceEvidence: Manufacturer explicitly identifies M25407N-0001, black sunray dial, 39 mm grade 2 titanium case, T-fit bracelet and complimentary black rubber strap. Hands-on article documents handling and photographing both supplied configurations. Actual photographed back visibly carries 25407 and TUDOR GENEVE CALIBRE MANUFACTURE inscriptions; that tooling stamp alone is not an alias for the incomplete inventory key 25407.

selectedImages: Three-hand blue Alinghi dial and black forged-carbon case with titanium crown/bezel edge. The neighbouring chronograph is excluded.
Blue fabric self-gripping strap and Tudor-shield titanium loop. The partly visible chronograph is a separate watch and does not supply model evidence.
reviewedArticles.referenceEvidence: Hands-on author documents photographing and wearing the three-hand Alinghi FXD; specification table explicitly identifies M25707KN-0001, blue dial, 42 mm forged-carbon case, titanium crown/bezel edge and blue textile Velcro strap. Manufacturer legacy product URL currently redirects to the family; it is not used as independent exact-reference confirmation. Chronograph and Black Bay images in the same article are excluded.

selectedImages: Black dial, red PELAGOS text, white blocks, 60-minute bezel and forest-green/red-thread fabric strap. Dive-event photograph of the documented hands-on specimen.
reviewedArticles.referenceEvidence: Manufacturer and hands-on specification table both explicitly identify M25717N-0001, black dial, titanium case, unidirectional 60-minute bezel and forest-green/red-thread fabric strap. Historical Navy watches, blue FXD and Alinghi chronographs in the same article are excluded. US Navy inspiration does not prove individual military issue.

https://www.fratellowatches.com/hands-on-with-the-adventurous-tudor-pelagos-fxd-gmt-zulu-time/ identifies M2542G247NU-0002, a 2024 Marine Nationale GMT with M.N.24 back. All 26 actual main article images inspected. Current manufacturer family https://www.tudorwatch.com/en/watches/pelagos-fxd and wildcard product https://www.tudorwatch.com/en/watches/pelagos-fxd/m2542gxx7nu-0002 identify 2542G267NU. Exact guessed product URLs for 2542G257 and 2542G247NU return 404. No documented alias from the inventory 2542G257 or 2542G267NU to the photographed 2024 reference is established. Similar visible dial and a shared MT5652-U calibre do not repair the reference/year boundary. All four categories withheld; further date-specific manufacturer/dealer evidence required. Current manufacturer metadata also explicitly maps its 2024 user-guide rmc m2542g247nu-0002 to cleanedRmc m2542gxx7nu-0002 and reuses 2024 product film. This documents a common model route, but does not establish the pictured M.N.24 caseback execution for an exact 2026 reference. Year-specific scope remains unresolved.
